# GRUB modules built into Canonical's signed GRUB CD image, the one this ISO boots through shim under Secure Boot:
# EFI/boot/grubx64.efi of ubuntu-26.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso (sha256 601e30fbf5d97759367c632e2c33630665039b7e2158fd068403da3ccf1bda1f),
# which is gcdx64.efi.signed of grub-efi-amd64-signed 1.215+2.14-2ubuntu1 (GRUB 2.14, Ubuntu 26.04.1 resolute).
# image: 2398088 bytes, sha256 dc505a15c1bd97878eede212a052a1bfb2f610176a5401a3679877c536fdcd62
# Under Secure Boot shim's lock refuses every module GRUB would load from disk, so the live menu (grub.cfg) can insmod only
# these. NOT in the list: all_video (the 24.04 image had it; the string "feature_all_video_module" in this binary is a
# feature flag, not the module), efi_uga, ntfs, pgp, video_bochs, video_cirrus.
# The disk image the Companion Stick ships (grubx64.efi.signed, 122 modules) is a superset of these 95:
# stick/crates/ci-stick/tests/fixtures/grub/grubx64.efi.signed.builtin-modules.txt
# Regenerate: 7z x ubuntu-26.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso EFI/boot/grubx64.efi
#             python3 -I stick/scripts/grub-builtin-modules.py EFI/boot/grubx64.efi
